candidates.title: ‘Catastrophic’ brake failure, neglected repairs contributed to deadly 2020 icefield bus rollover, judge finds
candidates.description: A complete failure of the braking system triggered by neglected mechanical repairs contributed to a deadly tour bus rollover in the Columbia Icefield, a fatality inquiry has concluded.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Alleged Tumbler Ridge co-conspirator James Cody Bryant 'danger to community,' prosecution argues
candidates.description: Assistant United States attorney Todd Greenberg, who is prosecuting the case against Bryant, has argued that Bryant poses a flight risk and a danger to the public, and should not be granted bail. He says there are substance abuse issues and mental health concerns that should also be factored in.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 3rd-party advertisers can’t appoint scrutineers in Alberta referendum and both sides aren’t happy about it
candidates.description: Elections Alberta told registered third-party advertisers they won't be able to appoint scrutineers in the upcoming referendum — a move drawing criticism from campaigners on both the federalist and separatist sides.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: B.C. NDP Leader David Eby defends family's enrolment in $10-a-day child-care
candidates.description: NDP Leader David Eby is defending his family's enrolment in British Columbia's $10-a-day child-care program. Eby is under attack from Conservatives who say his "wealthy family" should not benefit from the program that they say is inaccessible to many low-income families.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Quebec author accused of using AI admits past plagiarism but maintains novel is his own work
candidates.description: After spending the last few weeks quietly watching his reputation be torn apart, Quebec-based author Thélyson Orélien is speaking out and addressing the allegations that he used artificial intelligence to write his debut novel.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Pierre Poilievre visiting Detroit to push plan for U.S.-Canada trade deal
candidates.description: Pierre Poilievre is making a trip to Detroit Tuesday to pitch a plan for a “real deal” between Canada and the U.S. amid the ongoing trade war.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 'She was always proud': Inuk elder Emma Reelis dies at 78
candidates.description: Inuk Elder Emma Reelis shared her experience about residential schools, advocated for changes in the K-12 curriculum and was recognized in her lifetime with the King Charles III Coronation medal, the Queen's Diamond Jubilee Medal and a Seniors of Distinction Award.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Family of Byron Carr speaks out after murder charges in decades-old cold case withdrawn
candidates.description: The family of a P.E.I. teacher murdered in 1988 wants to know how key evidence went missing after the Crown announced Tuesday that all charges in the cold case had been withdrawn.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Newfoundland and Labrador MHAs should get a $22k raise, provincial report recommends
candidates.description: A 162-page report from the province's Members' Compensation Review Committee recommends MHAs get $117,000 a year, noting they have the second-lowest salary in Canada when compared to their provincial counterparts.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Ontario police warn of 'The Com' online network manipulating children into criminal acts
candidates.description: Durham police are warning the public about an online network of predators who target children online and manipulate them into criminal acts.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.description: Toronto police say a man identified at a downtown Toronto protest has been charged in connection with the burning of hundreds of Israeli flags earlier this month.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Parts of northwestern Ontario moving to permanent daylight saving time in November
candidates.description: The Province of Ontario has announced parts of northwestern Ontario will move to permanent daylight saving time on Nov. 1.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Mapping the genetics of a giant: New research decodes bison DNA
candidates.description: New research decoding their DNA is helping to shed light on how the collapse and slow, scattered return of herds to the landscapes they once dominated has forever changed the mighty species.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Vancouver sees record-setting number of cruise ship passenger visits in 2026, expects growth next year
candidates.description: Vancouver’s port authority is anticipating even more growth in 2027 after a record-setting year for cruise tourism in the city, which the authority says injected more than $1 billion into the local economy.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Saskatoon lawyer says homeless advocate was detained unjustly during encampment clearout
candidates.description: David Fineday's lawyer said he was arrested for mischief over $5,000 and held in police custody for the entire nine-hour duration of the encampment clear-out.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 2 roller coasters closed at Canada's Wonderland after someone dies on similar ride in Georgia
candidates.description: Canada’s Wonderland has closed two roller coasters after one person died and several others were injured in an incident on a similar ride at a Six Flags in Georgia on Monday.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Montreal's Goliath rollercoaster closed temporarily, following death at Six Flags in U.S.
candidates.description: According to the Associated Press, officials did not confirm how the person died, nor how the others were injured or their conditions after the incident at the park.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Charges withdrawn in 1988 P.E.I. cold case murder after key evidence lost
candidates.description: All charges laid in the cold case murder of P.E.I. teacher Byron Carr have been withdrawn because crucial evidence — including a knife found at the scene and the towel used to strangle Carr — are missing.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Cornell suspends all frat parties as alleged gang rape fuels continued calls for action
candidates.description: Cornell University has suspended all frat parties and events for the rest of the 2026-27 academic year, president Michael Kotlikoff announced Tuesday, as an alleged gang rape at one of the school's fraternities continues to fuel calls for action and accountability.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 12 U.S. senators, including 6 Republicans, tell Trump to drop diesel deal with Russia
candidates.description: A dozen U.S. senators, including six of U.S. President ‌Donald Trump's fellow Republicans, called on the president on Tuesday to rescind his diesel oil deal with Russia, days before his administration must decide whether to formally impose new sanctions on Moscow over its war in Ukraine.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Surgery confirms Pope has lung cancer, Vatican says
candidates.description: Pope Leo's surgery confirmed that he has lung cancer, and he had the lower lobe of his right lung removed, the Vatican said Tuesday.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: OpenAI says it used AI to identify suspect who planted listening device in office
candidates.description: OpenAI said on Tuesday that the Federal Bureau of Investigation had arrested one ‌of its employees in connection with a sophisticated listening device found hidden in one of the company's offices.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: IN PHOTOS | France student protests spread across Europe
candidates.description: Nationwide protests by high school students over education in France in recent weeks have spread to other parts of Europe.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Kimberly Guilfoyle, U.S. ambassador to Greece, resigns after reports alleging corruption
candidates.description: U.S. President Donald Trump's ambassador to Greece, Kimberly Guilfoyle, resigned on Tuesday after allegations of improper conduct but insisted she'll "vigorously defend" herself.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Duane (Keffe D) Davis sentenced to 40 years to life in prison for murder of rapper Tupac Shakur
candidates.description: Duane (Keffe D) Davis received a sentence of to 40 years to life in prison Tuesday for orchestrating the murder of rap icon Tupac Shakur, who was gunned down off the Las Vegas Strip over 30 years ago.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Students in France clash with riot police amid weekslong education protests

The report comes as economic and financial leaders gathered in Bangkok for the fall meetings of the IMF and World Bank.

Minnesotans organized grassroots opposition against the federal officers. Now many of those same people have signed up for training to protect the polls in a Senate race that could be pivotal.

candidates.title: Red Flag Warning issued October 13 at 1:49PM PDT until October 16 at 10:00PM PDT by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
candidates.description: ***CORRECTED SYNOPSIS*** ...HIGH RISK FOR EXTREME FIRE BEHAVIOR WITH ANY NEW FIRE STARTS THURSDAY THROUGH FRIDAY DUE TO MODERATE TO LOCALLY STRONG SANTA ANA WINDS AND LOW RELATIVE HUMIDITY... .Moderate to locally strong Santa Ana winds will quickly develop on Thursday, peak Thursday afternoon through Friday afternoon, then weaken through the weekend. Meanwhile, dry air will settle over the region and dry out any helpful effects of the recent rains. The previous Fire Weather Watches were upgraded to Red Flag Warnings. Some of the windiest areas may see Red Flag conditions linger into Saturday. As the winds expand Thursday Night into Friday, Red Flag conditions may form over the interior mountains of Santa Barbara and San Luis Obispo Counties on Friday, where a Fire Weather Watch is now in effect. * AFFECTED AREA...The mountains of Los Angeles and Ventura Counties. * TIMING...From 6 AM Thursday to 10 PM PDT Friday. * WINDS...Northeast to east 20 to 40 mph with gusts of 50 to 70 mph. * RELATIVE HUMIDITY...Minimums of 8 to 20 percent common. * IMPACTS...If fire ignition occurs, conditions are favorable for extreme fire behavior which would threaten life and property.

candidates.title: Winter Weather Advisory issued October 13 at 2:48PM MDT until October 14 at 6:00AM MDT by NWS Salt Lake City UT
candidates.description: * WHAT...Snow. Additional snow accumulations up to two to four inches. * WHERE...Western Uinta Mountains. * WHEN...Until 6 AM MDT Wednesday. * IMPACTS...Winter driving conditions are expected. * ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Seasonal roads such as Bald Mountain Pass remain open at this time and may pose a significant risk to under-prepared travelers. If traveling along high elevation routes, be prepared for periods of accumulating road snow.

candidates.title: Winter Weather Advisory issued October 13 at 2:48PM MDT until October 14 at 6:00AM MDT by NWS Salt Lake City UT
candidates.description: * WHAT...Snow expected, particularly for elevations above 8,500ft. Total snow accumulations of 3 to 6 inches in upper Little and Big Cottonwood, with higher amounts expected for elevations above 9,000ft. * WHERE...Wasatch Mountains South of I-80. * WHEN...Until 6 AM MDT Wednesday. * IMPACTS...Winter driving conditions are expected. * ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Early season snowfall on roadways may pose a significant risk to under-prepared travelers. While minor snow accumulations are expected for upper Little and Big Cottonwood Canyon, Guardsman Pass will likely see higher snowfall potential. If traveling along this route, be prepared for winter driving conditions.
